summary: Reconstructs a color image and smooths it through temporal accumulation.

remarks: Combines a spatial pass with previous-frame history. Uses spatial reconstruction when matching geometry guidance is unavailable. Call ResetAccumulation after discontinuous scene changes. Use [`UDRQuality`](<xref:UDRQuality>) for resolution presets.
